title: Scalar-compatible comparison of derived additive etale and ordinary structure-sheaf first cohomology
statement: Let k be a field, f:C -> Spec(k) a separated finite-type curve [def-sc-curves], G a sheaf of abelian groups with coefficients in universe u+1, and a_U:G(U) ≃+ Γ(U,O_U) natural for etale restriction. Let T denote first derived etale cohomology on a sheaf in degree zero [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology]. There exists an additive equivalence e:T(G) ≃+ H^1(C,O_C) [pqf-def-cohomology] such that for every c in k and every sheaf endomorphism mu satisfying a_U(mu_U(x)) = a_U(x) times the pullback of c, one has e(T(mu)(x)) = c smul e(x). The action on H^1 is its canonical action induced by f. No smoothness, connectedness, algebraic closure, properness or finite-dimensionality is assumed.

source.place: Tag 03P2, Theorem 59.22.4, separated-case finite affine cover proof; Tag 03FD, Lemma 21.12.4, natural module/abelian comparison; coefficient lift and scalar encoding supplied by R1.

proof.text: Use natural unit-module tensor-section coordinates to construct a sheaf isomorphism G to the lifted associated unit sheaf, with components a followed by inverse coordinates and ULift.up. Naturality follows directly from ha and naturality of the coordinates. IsCurve supplies compactness and absolute separatedness.
Compose inverse Ext/derived comparison, cohomology of the constructed sheaf isomorphism and the canonical natural lifted-tensor/source-H comparison.

For each scalar c put r=f*(c), phi=multiplication by r and theta=phi_et. The section formulas show mu followed by the sheaf isomorphism equals the isomorphism followed by ULift(theta). Functoriality and naturality of each comparison give the corresponding equality on H. The definitions of moduleH and moduleHOfField identify the resulting H.map phi with c-smul.
